entries.about: Zimnina is a standard local Bulgarian brand known for jarred traditional vegetables and preserved legumes.
entries.value_case: A decent pantry backup for quick meals, but as a frugal household with ample time and equipment, dried beans offer significantly better nutritional and economic value per edible kilo.

entries.market_insight: Supermarkets in Bulgaria frequently discount dried beans during autumn harvest sales, which aligns much better with this household's bulk-buying strategy.

entries.red_flags: Heavy glass jars take up substantial shelf footprint compared to the equivalent yield of dried beans.

entries.name: Cow's Milk Mizo 3,5% UHT
entries.headline: Stock up: buy 12 L = €8.70, saves €8.70 · Cow's Milk Mizo 3,5% UHT — €0.72/L vs €1.45 an estimated reference (50% under) · capped at Fair — no shelf price observed yet, so this reference is an LLM estimate · Only UHT stacks; a case keeps ~6 months unopened · valid to 16 May
entries.about: Mizo is a prominent Hungarian dairy brand heavily imported into Bulgaria, producing standard, reliable UHT milk.
entries.value_case: This is a remarkably efficient way to buy milk for a family with a 4-year-old. While not a deep promo, the baseline cost per litre is highly competitive against private-label 1L cartons.
entries.the_math: The price is 1.45 EUR for a 2L carton. No discount is claimed, but it effectively sits at 0.725 EUR per litre, an excellent everyday baseline.
entries.market_insight: UHT milk under 0.80 EUR per litre is increasingly rare in the region without buying large multipacks, making this everyday shelf price worth locking in.
entries.bulk_advice: UHT milk stores at room temperature for months. Given the dedicated storage room and toddler consumption, buying by the case (usually 6 units) is highly recommended.
entries.red_flags: Check the cardboard seams on delivery; 2L UHT cartons can occasionally suffer from micro-leaks if dropped during warehouse handling.
entries.label: UHT milk (1 L)

entries.headline: Stock up: buy 60 pc = €19.12, saves €133.88 · Toilet Paper Emeka Paradise — €0.32/pc vs €2.55 an estimated reference (88% under) · capped at Fair — no shelf price observed yet, so this reference is an LLM estimate · Shelf-stable; buy 4 packs at a time · valid to 31 Jul
entries.about: Emeka is a widely recognized mainstream Bulgarian toilet paper brand (produced by Ficosota), usually offering standard 3-ply quality.
entries.value_case: This is a strictly average everyday price for a necessary consumable. It's safe to buy for immediate needs but not priced low enough to trigger a major stock-up.
entries.the_math: Priced at 2.55 EUR for 8 rolls, yielding around 0.31 EUR per roll. This aligns directly with standard retail pricing with no artificial inflation.
entries.market_insight: Paper products in Bulgaria operate on an aggressive High-Low promo cycle. Major brands like Emeka and Milde routinely see 30-40% discounts on bulk sacks (24+ rolls) at hypermarkets every 4-6 weeks.
entries.bulk_advice: Lightweight but takes up high-volume space. With a large storage room, you can hold months of supply, but wait for a 24- or 32-roll promo to fill the space efficiently.
entries.red_flags: 8-packs often have fewer sheets per roll than the larger 24-pack promotional bundles from the same brand.
entries.label: Toilet paper
